name: literature search, round 2 (general 2D geometry)
purpose: first end-to-end demonstration from a newly found paper to certified results, after the search was brought in line with the general 2D geometry (holes, inclined edges) on 26 Nov
changes_since_round_1: screening and scout accept straight inclined edges and circular or polygonal holes
queries added: plate with a hole, Cook's membrane (linear), neo-Hookean Cook
code refuses nu > 0.49 in the definition step (displacement elements lock)

predictions.P1_end_to_end: at least one paper read reaches verdicts: code verification PASS (or the post hoc R2 path, labelled) and at least one quantity certified
predictions.P2_general_geometry_used: at least one paper read is represented with geometry_kind='polygon' (an inclined edge or a hole)
predictions.P3_refusals_correct: every paper read that does not reach verdicts stops with a stated reason that matches the paper (checked by hand afterwards and labelled as such)
predictions.P4_no_silent_change: no description contains a number that is neither traced to the source text nor flagged as assumed (code check trace_numbers)
predictions.P5_cost: the LLM cost stays at or below USD 5

scoring: by hand from literature_search_runs/<stamp>.json and autonomous_runs/<paper id>/run.json; P3 is a human judgement and is reported as such
not_changed: acceptance criteria, gates and tolerances are unchanged

attempts.status: invalid (code error, see the run file)

budget_note: the USD 5 approval covers both attempts together: attempt 2 runs with budget 5 minus the cost of attempt 1
